title: Yellow Charred Jamaican Tofu Skewers
description: Charred and creamy Jamaican dish featuring balsamic vinegar, perfect for a post-workout meal, this shojin-friendly recipe is a great option for those looking for a healthy and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, scotch bonnet peppers, garlic, thyme, and allspice, and blend until smooth.
Place the tofu cubes in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, tossing to coat.
Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and increase the oven temperature to broil.
Broil the skewers for an additional 5 minutes, or until lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
